people.name: Paul

people.name: Rome
people.line: Capital city of the Roman Empire

translations.web: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.
translations.bsb: When we arrived in Rome, Paul was permitted to stay by himself, with a soldier to guard him.
translations.kjv: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.
translations.asv: And when we entered into Rome, Paul was suffered to abide by himself with the soldier that guarded him.
